title: Horrific Customer Service and arrived damaged
text: Horrific Customer Service and arrived damaged. Just received my Foodi and it was broken in multiple spots and looked like it had been dropped a few times. I called Ninja customer service and they told me that it's just cosmetic and will still work fine. I expressed that I found that ridiculous since I did not pay for a damaged item, and then they told me they'd replace the bottom base if I paid shipping costs, like they were doing me a favor! Very unhappy and actually shocked at their customer service that they could not have cared less that I spent a very decent amount of money and it should have arrived undamaged.
